Cost: Provided with the Operating System
Slots: 5

Cyberdeck with 5 slots that take Programs or Hardware. Once per Round, when a DV10 or higher Quickhack from this deck fails by 2 or less, the user may spend a remaining NET Action to retry it at -1.

Foundry notes:

  • Comes with the Operating System that requires it, so its price is 0 here.

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Operating Systems > Cyberdeck Port Operating Systems).
